en.NAME: REVIEW API BASE URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Absolute https origin of the Core deployment with no path, for example https://dev-1.servicewand.com. Any other value is discarded and the page reports that it is not set up. The link token is read only from the #token= fragment of the address the client opens; no token, account or customer value is configured here.

en.NAME: PORTAL URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Absolute https address of the customer portal, for example https://portal.example.com/. When set, an approved agreement offers an Open the customer portal button above and below its text, and a closed link offers it once; while empty, the page explains portal access without a button. Any other value is discarded and no button shows. It is only linked to: no account, user or token value is configured here.

en.NAME: REVIEW MAPS API KEY
en.DESCRIPTION: Google Maps browser key: address suggestions and a map for the billing address on the Confirm your choices step, and each property's plan drawn over a satellite map on its card. Use the same browser key as the quote form's FORM_MAPS_API_KEY, restricted by HTTP referrer to this host and to the Maps JavaScript, Places and Geocoding APIs; it is visible in page source, as every browser key is. Set the value in the page's PageContext, not in the template: the package ships it empty so an upload never overwrites it. While it is empty or not a key, no Google script is loaded, the billing address stays a plain text field and each plan is drawn as an outline of its shapes. With a key the page sends its origin, never its path or link, as the referrer, because Google checks a browser key against it.
